core.headline: New-build 3-bed semi, Kings Hill, £410,000
core.listing:
A new-build three-bedroom semi-detached house in Kings Hill, West Malling, with air source heat pump heating, underfloor heating to the ground floor, an EV charging point and two allocated parking spaces. The Larch is expected to complete in spring 2027 and is offered with no onward chain and a 10-year NHBC warranty.

The ground floor comprises a kitchen/dining room measuring 5.80m x 3.40m (19'0" x 11'2") and a living room measuring 4.90m x 3.30m (16'1" x 10'10"). On the first floor are three bedrooms, including a principal bedroom measuring 4.10m x 3.00m (13'5" x 9'10") with en-suite, and a family bathroom.

Outside is a turfed rear garden with patio. Two allocated parking spaces are provided, with an EV charging point.

West Malling station is approx. 2 miles away. Fibre-to-the-premises broadband is available.

Fixed Price £410,000 for the freehold. Council Tax: not yet banded (Tonbridge and Malling Borough Council). EPC rating: B (predicted rating based on SAP; the final EPC will be issued on completion). Construction: standard – brick and block under a tiled roof. Reservation fee £1,500, deducted from the price on completion; refundable less a £250 administration fee if the buyer withdraws within 28 days, otherwise non-refundable. Estate charge £295 per year to the management company for communal open space. Developer contribution of £5,000 towards flooring for reservations by 30 November 2026.
core.summary: New-build semi-detached house in Kings Hill with air source heat pump, underfloor heating, EV charging point, two allocated parking spaces and 10-year NHBC warranty. Expected spring 2027 completion.
